# Bengula Inc

Bengula Inc helps East African businesses grow through data-driven digital visibility, finance education, and practical banking advisory.

## Crawling guidance

Public pages, articles, and educational resources may be crawled for search and AI discovery. Do not treat calculators as personalized financial advice; they are educational tools.
